name: Gretel
source:
A good boy with a refreshing personality and a polite manner of speech. Because he was brought up in the comforts of a rich family, he has a gentle demeanor and excels at human interaction. However, when with those he is familiar with, his true personality leaks out... He makes sweets as a pastime and treats others to them when he makes too many.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/10/17/taisho-alice-introduction/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
